subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should maintainers require live WSL reproduction before authorizing another agent-tools test cleanup, given the current labels and the partial open closing PR?
rationale: Source still shows the reported harness shape, but the item is labeled for maintainer review and live repro, and the only open closing PR changes a different fs-safe test surface.

options.title: Wait for live WSL proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or contributor reruns the two affected agent-tools tests on WSL and confirms the current failure mode.

options.title: Allow source-based cleanup
options.body: Permit a narrow test-only PR that reuses shared temp-dir helpers and adds only justified WSL guards, then require WSL proof before merge.

options.title: Retarget the linked PR
options.body: Ask the open fs-safe PR author to remove the closing link or explicitly explain why that PR should be considered only a partial related cleanup.

recommendation.title: Wait for live WSL proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or contributor reruns the two affected agent-tools tests on WSL and confirms the current failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The old-path history and prior detailed review make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the test-harness proof decision.
